title: Warehouse Lineage Record
description: Tracks the provenance and transformation chain of a Warehouse artifact. Every canonical artifact MUST carry a lineage record.

artifact_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this artifact. Recommended: UUID or slugged canonical path.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this artifact was created or last materially changed.

created_by.description: Agent or operator that created this artifact. Use 'human:<handle>' or 'agent:<name>'.

derived_from.description: Ordered list of source artifact IDs this artifact was derived from. Empty for root artifacts.

authority_source.description: Path or ID of the single authoritative location for this artifact family.

reflection_sources.description: Paths or IDs of known non-authoritative mirrors or reflections of this artifact.

hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the canonical artifact at creation time. Optional but strongly recommended.

supersedes.description: Artifact ID of the previous version this record supersedes, if any.

superseded_by.description: Artifact ID that supersedes this record, if known.
